race.comment: METALCRAFT (4) was having his first start for the new yard and returning from a break when leading throughout to score a dominant win at Rockhampton. Fitter and will take catching again. CHARTWELL (3) has been racing well, finishing runner-up two back then scoring last time in a BM70 here. Confidence is back and is among the main hopes. KHUMBILA (1) has placed 3/4 over this course and distance and is one of the major players. MATERIALIST (7) hit the hard in the BM70 here last time and just missed. Will appreciate the hot tempo and is expected to be winding up late again. LA PETITE MAISON (5) has been freshened after racing below par last time. Worth another chance.
